CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.create_term_edit_draft(p_term_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select gym20.create_term_draft_from_published(p_term_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.get_student_exercises_by_code(p_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',e.id,'title',e.title,'is_completed',e.is_completed,
    'completed_at',e.completed_at,'created_at',e.created_at
  ) order by e.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  from gym20.student_exercises e
  join gym20.student_public_links l on l.student_id=e.student_id
  where l.code=p_code and p_code ~ '^[0-9a-f]{12}$';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.get_student_public_link(p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'gym20', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select l.code
  from gym20.student_public_links l
  where l.student_id = p_student_id
    and exists (
      select 1 from gym20.profiles p
      where p.id = (select auth.uid())
        and p.role = 'owner'
        and p.is_active = true
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.get_student_public_schedule_by_code(p_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with target as (
    select l.student_id, s.full_name
    from gym20.student_public_links l
    join gym20.students s on s.id = l.student_id
    where l.code = p_code and p_code ~ '^[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    limit 1
  ),
  term_rows as (
    select t.id,t.term_name,t.term_order,t.start_date,t.end_date,
      coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',cs.id,'session_number',cs.session_number,'starts_at',cs.starts_at,
          'ends_at',cs.ends_at,'coach_name',cs.coach_name,'venue',cs.venue,
          'notes',cs.notes,'attendance',coalesce(a.status,'pending')
        ) order by cs.starts_at,cs.session_number)
        from gym20.class_sessions cs
        left join lateral (
          select at.status from gym20.attendance at
          where at.session_id=cs.id and at.student_id=(select student_id from target)
          order by at.created_at desc limit 1
        ) a on true
        where cs.schedule_version_id=t.published_version_id
      ),'[]'::jsonb) as sessions
    from gym20.student_terms t
    join gym20.term_schedule_versions v on v.id=t.published_version_id and v.term_id=t.id and v.status='published'
    where t.student_id=(select student_id from target)
  )
  select case when exists(select 1 from target) then
    jsonb_build_object(
      'student',(select jsonb_build_object('full_name',full_name) from target),
      'terms',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',id,'term_name',term_name,'term_order',term_order,'start_date',start_date,
        'end_date',end_date,'sessions',sessions
      ) order by term_order nulls last,start_date desc nulls last) from term_rows),'[]'::jsonb)
    )
  else null end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.is_active_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from gym20.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.role = 'owner'
      and p.is_active = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.public_registration_courses()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, description text, class_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select c.id, c.name, c.description, c.class_type
  from gym20.courses as c
  where c.is_active = true
  order by c.name;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gym20.verify_student_push_cron_secret(p_secret text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    p_secret is not null
    and p_secret = (
      select ds.decrypted_secret
      from vault.decrypted_secrets ds
      where ds.name = 'gym20_student_push_cron_secret'
      limit 1
    ),
    false
  );
$function$
